entries.body: Celebrate and reignite your romance with a three-night stay, highlighted by a magical candlelit dinner on the beach.
entries.title: Seaside Wedding & Honeymoon

entries.body: Reconnect with the soothing sea breeze and let the gentle waves of Sanur Beach nourish your body, mind, and spirit.
entries.title: Hideaway stay

entries.body: Experience Sanur's unpretentious hidden gem with its gentle sound of the sea in the culinary adventure of Tandjung Sari's signature Mini Rijsttafel dinner for two.
entries.title: Stay & Dine

entries.body: Discover the secrets of authentic Indonesian home-cooking while explore the exotic ingredients with traditional cooking techniques by our Chef.
entries.title: Cooking Class

entries.body: Our boutique, Kado (meaning 'gift'), highlights Bali's finest artisans. Many homewares in your bungalow are available for purchase here, along with curated fashion items, jewelry, and books.
entries.title: Kado Gift Shop

intro.body: To enhance our guests' experience, we offer a range of curated packages and activities designed for your leisure and deepen your understanding of the creativity-inspiring Balinese art and culture.
intro.heading: The small town of Sanur offers a picturesque coastal area and nearby attractions. At Tandjung Sari, where the beach is attentively nurtured, guests are invited to experience Sanur at its finest, aligning with the idea of "A Magical Door to Bali."
